posts.cooked:
An impressive turnout at Arsenal tonight -- 13 people, with four games going simultaneously!

 

Towards the end of the evening I was in a hurry but another person was interested in playing against a villain on advanced. We decided to try Baron Blade on advanced. I must have done that at some point, but not in a LONG time. Wow does Blade go through cards quickly on advanced versus five people. We won! It was certainly a quick game. So quick we had enough time to try Mad Bomber Blade on advanced. We wont that one, too, but it seemed a bit touch and go for a bit.

 

First game of the night? Two hours defeating Gloomweaver. Second and third games took less than an hour total.
